summary: StudentPayInformation manages student payroll details, including annual increment date, union membership, bank account information, and provides UI for display, insert, and update. It involves form controls, data binding, validation, and database procedures for CRUD operations.
purpose: To capture and maintain student pay information such as increment date, union membership, and banking details, with business logic for validation and user interface workflows for editing and displaying information.

workflows.name: Display Student Pay Information
steps: FormView displays student pay info, disables/enables edit based on ScreenIsEditable and ReadOnly.

workflows.name: Add Student Pay Information
steps: User initiates Insert mode in the FormView.
Form fields entered: AnnualIncrementDate, UnionMembershipCodeID, BankAccountName, AccountNumber.

workflows.name: Edit Student Pay Information
steps: User initiates Edit mode in FormView.
Displays edit fields for pay information.

workflows.name: Union Membership DropDown Binding
steps: On DataBound, UnionMembership dropdown is populated via Codes.CodeSearch.
Dropdown value and description mapped via ID and Description fields.

business_rules: Annual increment date cannot be a leap year day (Feb 29).
Union membership must be selected from allowed codes.
If no pay information found, creates a stub record for the student.
validations: AnnualIncrementDate is checked for null and not being Feb 29.
Bank account name and number provided before update/insert.
calculations: AnnualIncrementDateFormatted is generated from AnnualIncrementDate using DateFormatter.FormatDateMonthDay.
conditions: Screen is editable if ScreenIsEditable is true.
UnionMembership dropdown binds only if control found.
system_behavior: Hides or shows edit and save buttons based on ScreenIsEditable and ReadOnly.
Disables edit fields if screen not editable.
dependencies: Database stored procedures: StudentDetailsPayInformationSearch, StudentDetailsPayInformationAdd, StudentDetailsPayInformationUpdate.
HSPnetSession for session state and DB access.
exceptions: AnnualIncrementDate is leap day; error message shown.
content_gaps: Detailed UI layout, error handling, and security validation for bank account fields not fully described.
Stored procedure implementation details not available.
